label: S5 node is the S4 node plus a symmetric frame (inference)
rule: Frame-condition algebra: a reflexive Euclidean frame is symmetric and transitive; a reflexive transitive symmetric frame is Euclidean
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration S5 node strengthens S4 node: for every world type, signature, profile, world and relation, the S5 node holds iff the S4 node holds and the route's frame is symmetric. Premise-free; it compares the two encodings and asserts no frame class of the route.
